name: Four-shade handheld
summary: A 160×144 screen with four shades of one olive-green hue. Every house and room is drawn from 8×8 tiles in light, two mid tones and dark, so form lives only in value and pattern.

philosophy.core_thesis: Four values of one colour are enough for a world, if the pattern and the outline carry the form.
design_principles: Use exactly 4 shades: lightest for the ground, darkest for outlines.
Draw at 160×144 pixels on an 8×8 tile grid.
Separate materials with dither and hatch patterns, not with hue.
Keep large areas in the lightest shade so the screen stays readable.
Outline every object in the darkest shade, 1 px.
Make a character 16×16 px, with a top-down or side view.
anti_patterns: Large dark areas that smear on the slow screen

projection_and_camera.camera: Flips screen by screen or scrolls with the player.
projection_and_camera.framing: 20 tiles across and 18 down; the player near the centre.

geometry.budget: 40 sprites, 10 on one line; 384 tiles in memory.
geometry.proportion: A character is 2 tiles high; a house is 4 by 4 tiles.

surface.texture_rule: Materials are 2-shade patterns: dots for grass, lines for wood, checks for stone.

palette.strategy: One hue in 4 values, set by the screen, not by the artist.

lighting.model: None; value is painted into the tiles.
lighting.shadows: A darkest-shade strip under a roof or a tree.
lighting.atmosphere: The slight blur of the slow liquid-crystal screen.
lighting.time_of_day: Not shown, or a palette swap toward darker values.

world_and_space.scale: A room is one screen; a town is 4 to 9 screens.
world_and_space.interiors: Top-down rooms with walls as a 1-tile border, a rug and a table as tiles.
world_and_space.exteriors: Roofs seen from above, paths of patterned tiles between them.
world_and_space.threshold: Step on a door tile; fade to the room screen.

principles.rule: Draw a door 1 tile wide and a character 2 tiles high.
Keep paths at least 2 tiles wide so the player moves without a stop.
Mark the door with the darkest shade so the eye finds it first.

interface.placement: A text box on the bottom 4 tile rows, or a 1-row strip.
interface.type_and_icons: An 8×8 pixel font; icons as single tiles.

canonical_works.work: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening

emotion.target_response: A quiet, pocket-sized focus: the viewer leans in to a small green world.

avoid_when: The brief needs hue contrast between areas.

modifiers.how: Keep the tiles; move to a fixed palette of about 25 colours.
Keep the small palette; turn the grid 45° into an isometric view.
